name: Game Afoot

description.content: While chasing the Obsession, whenever you basic-break Pallets or Breakable Walls, or damage Generators, you gain [7%] [Haste] for [10s].
Whenever you damage the Survivor with the most chase time with a basic-attack, they become the Obsession.

quote: "This one might actually be a challenge..." -Adriana Imai
